Trapinch

Ground

Hoenn · Generation 3

Trapinch is a Ground-type Ant Pit Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.7 m tall and weighs 15 kg. It evolves into Vibrava. Its highest base stat is Attack (100), with a base stat total of 290.
